name: Swayam Saksham Yojana (GTKVN)
benefit: **Loan Amount:** - Up to ₹5,00,000/-. **Interest Rate:** - 5% per annum. **Contribution Split:** - 95% of the business/project cost is covered under the scheme as a loan. - 5% contribution must be made by the beneficiary. **Loan Repayment Terms:** - Repayable in 60 equal monthly installments (maximum 5 years). - The repayment period depends on the nature of the business plan.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Thakor or Koli caste/community. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age on the date of application. 1. The applicant should have technical/professional education or experience in the field of business/trade. 1. The applicant should be unemployed and looking to start a self-employment unit. 1. The applicant family’s annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should have completed professional education in areas such as Medical, Law, Architecture, Engineering, Chartered Accountancy, Hotel Management, Software/Hardware, Financial Consultancy, Sculpture or Wrestling (with training) etc. > **Note:** Out of total loans disbursed, at least 50% will be allocated to families with income up to ₹1,50,000/-.
